title: Cost Centre / Department
description: The profit-centre bucket — New Trucks, Used Trucks, Parts, Service, Body Shop — that revenue and cost roll up into for departmental reporting.
x-api-note: Department/cost-centre structure is documented only through the GL account department-suffix convention and Department-Id header scoping; no standalone Fortellis 'department master' API was found.
x-confidence-legend: Every property carries x-confidence: documented | inferred | unverified, copied from docs/model/model.json field-level confidence -- never uniform across an entity.

department_suffix_2_digit_on_gl_account.description: The 2-digit code appended to a GL account number identifying its department, e.g. -01 = New Vehicle Dept

department_id_fortellis_header.description: The header value that scopes every Fortellis API call to one specific department/DMS-type combination
department_id_fortellis_header.x-source-title: CDK Drive Get Customer v3 PDF

absorption_rate_fixed_ops_metric.description: A named KPI measuring whether fixed operations (Service + Parts) gross profit covers total dealership fixed expenses

reporting_account_department_roll_up_to_.description: The mapping from a department's internal accounts to the manufacturer's own statement format
reporting_account_department_roll_up_to_.x-cdk-field-name: Reporting Account (department roll-up to factory statement)
reporting_account_department_roll_up_to_.x-source-title: Dominion DMS help — Create a new sales general ledger account

company_number_store_level_department_sc.description: Departments are scoped per Company Number/store, so 'Service' at one rooftop is a separate cost centre from 'Service' at another
company_number_store_level_department_sc.x-source-title: MindBridge — CDK ERP: Export the general ledger

department_name_new_vehicle_used_vehicle.description: The standard NADA/NIADA department set every dealer chart of accounts is built around, with Service+Parts+Body Shop jointly called 'Fixed Operations'
department_name_new_vehicle_used_vehicle.x-cdk-field-name: Department name (New Vehicle / Used Vehicle / Parts / Service / Body Shop / Rental / F&I / Admin)
department_name_new_vehicle_used_vehicle.x-source-title: NIADA Dealership Chart of Accounts Manual

per_rooftop_department_id_set.description: Fortellis community guidance confirms each physical store/rooftop has its own set of Department-Ids, visible in the app's subscription report
